{{Top|leg}}
The '''Skills system''' was an advanced upgrade of the [[skills implant]]. This device stimulated chemicals in the brain in order to significantly enhance general problem solving and data processing abilities. It allowed for a noticeable increase in the performance quality of skill-related tasks, making it a valuable implant of its type.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 16 or higher.
